# ADR Template

This template is mirrored from, and should be kept identical to, [docs/adr/ADR-000-template.md](../adr/ADR-000-template.md) — that is the canonical version used by the `/create-adr` command. This copy exists here only so `docs/templates/` is a complete one-stop index of every document template in the repository.

If you are creating a real ADR, copy `docs/adr/ADR-000-template.md`, not this file.
